transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Lee. Could you start by telling me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Lee. Well, I came in because I just keep beating myself up lately. I've been feeling like... like I'm not really senior material at my job, and I somehow just fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can. It's just been really weighing on me.
How long have you been feeling this way—has it been a matter of weeks, or has this been more of a long-standing pattern over months or years?
It's definitely been more than just a few weeks. Um, looking back at it, these low, guilty periods have been hanging around... off and on for about eleven months now.
Over these past 11 months, would you say you've felt down and guilty almost every day without much relief, or does it come in waves with stretches where you feel essentially back to normal?

Well, it hasn't been just a constant low for the whole eleven months. It does come in waves. But... the really noticeable up-and-down pattern, that actually just started about a month ago. It was right after I was asked to step up and cover the senior analyst duties at work.

Since this stepped-up role began a month ago, have you also noticed changes like loss of interest in things you used to enjoy, changes in your sleep or appetite, or trouble concentrating, in addition to the low mood and guilt?

Yeah, I've definitely noticed a loss of interest. Um, usually I really look forward to grilling on the weekend, or going fishing, or just putting on a record. But lately... I just leave the stuff sitting there. I just don't really care to do any of it right now.
Before this past year, have you ever had a similar period of low mood and guilt that lasted for several weeks or more, followed by a stretch where you felt completely back to your normal self?

No, I don't think so. I mean, not that I can remember. This whole thing... feeling this down and guilty for this long, it really just seems like it's been the last eleven months. Before that, I felt fine.
Over this past month, have you noticed any changes in your sleep—such as trouble falling asleep, waking up frequently, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah, my sleep has definitely been off. Um, it's kind of two different things happening. Sometimes I'll wake up way too early, just... my brain is already going over client tickets and work stuff, and I just can't get back to sleep. And then other times, I'll actually sleep a normal amount of hours, but I still wake up feeling completely worn out, like I didn't rest at all.
Over this past month, have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight, or found it harder than usual to concentrate on tasks at work?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely been off lately. I just haven't been very hungry. A lot of times I'll just grab a few bites of something, or honestly, I'll just end up skipping supper altogether. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, but I have noticed my belt is a little looser than normal. And as for work... yeah, concentrating has been pretty tough. It's just hard to stay focused on what I'm supposed to be doing.
